_crash_reports: Stock 8C148 has none of the CrashReporter directories: ReportCrash silently drops every .crash/.plist, so an unexplained SpringBoard exit leaves no reason in the log or on the card (issue 1). /Library/Logs is a stock symlink to /private/var/log, so these are the real directories behind all three paths scripts/crashlogs.py reads.
_status_bar_image: SpringBoard asks for Black_CARRIER_.png with an empty carrier name (no carrier bundle on the 3DS) and logs 'Could not find mapped image' on every boot. This 1x1 transparent PNG is our own, stops the warning and changes no pixels.
_cydia: Cydia + APT/dpkg base system, downloaded at build time (scripts/cydia.py, docs/cydia.md); false = no Cydia
_tlsfix: TLSFix 1.3 (MIT, github.com/ObscureMosquito/TLSFix, fork of nfzerox/TLSFix): Cydia Substrate tweak that runs iOS's TLS through OpenSSL 1.1.1 (TLS 1.2/1.3), verified against the trust store below; part of the Cydia set (rootfs/cydia.json, group tlsfix); false = leave it out
_cydia_plist_write: plists written only when Cydia is in the image (scripts/mkrootfs.py, after the Cydia install). IconState.plist: the home screen layout SpringBoard writes on the first boot of a 4.2.1 iPod2,1 rootfs (read back from the image, Utilities folder included) with Cydia moved from page 2 to the first free slot of page 1; without this file SpringBoard puts Cydia alone on page 2 (re-log 77)
_trust_store: current root certificates (RSA roots of Mozilla's bundle) as user anchors in securityd's trust store, which every SecTrust evaluation (Safari, Cydia, NSURLConnection) consults; scripts/certs.py, docs/certificates.md

trust_store._profile: RSA + EC roots (roots-ec.pem) as a configuration profile's CA payloads: TLSFix verifies chains with EC certificates, which iOS 4.2.1's Security.framework cannot, with OpenSSL against the profiles in this folder

liblockdown stub: lockdown_copy_value looks the key up in a table (next patch) and returns its constant value, else NULL (offline research activation; no lockdownd). Before re-log 62 it knew only ActivationState and BrickState, so UIDevice.model (DeviceClass) was "Unknown": Settings > Wallpaper looked in /Library/Wallpaper/Unknown and showed an empty page

lockdown_copy_value's table, in the dead body of lockdown_copy_buid_identity (stubbed above): {key variable, value} pairs, 0-terminated, then the new constant CFStrings: ActivationState = "Activated", BrickState = kCFBooleanFalse, DeviceClass = "iPod", DeviceName = "iPod", ProductType = "iPod2,1", ProductVersion = "4.2.1", BuildVersion = "8C148", HardwareModel = "N72AP"
OpenGLES _eagl_init: IOServiceMatching("AppleMBXDevice") -> "IOResources" (always registered), so EAGL loads MBXGLEngine.bundle = tools/ios3ds-gl (docs/gpu.md)

QuartzCore CA::WindowServer::M2Display ctor: the display surface format for an ES1 (API 1) GL compositor is the literal 'L565' (16 bpp); make it 'BGRA' like API 2 so CA's GL compositor renders the 32 bpp format the CLCD scans out and the screen mirror reads (docs/gpu.md 7)

VirtualAudio (mediaserverd's routing plug-in) picks its routing database by matching hw.model against the product table at 0x287210 (K48 ... N72 N81 ...). N72's database has no built-in microphone (input only from a wired headset), so iOS reports no input. Swap the N72 slot to 'X72' and the N81 (iPod touch 4G: speaker, headphones, built-in mic, no receiver) slot to 'N72': this N72 now routes like an N81 and gets MicrophoneBuiltIn, backed by the codec's 'imic' data source (dt_audio.py ain2b-intmic) and the 3DS microphone (docs/audio.md)

CoreMotion CLPlatformInfo::getProviders (0x33224b18): sensor bit mask per hw.model; N72 (iPod2,1, shared with N45/N18) has 0x2012, the same word with bit 6 (gyro, CLIoHidManager::isEventTypeAvailable(20)) is N81's 0x2052. Without it CMMotionManager.gyroAvailable / deviceMotionAvailable stay NO whatever IOKit offers. Literal at 0x33224dd4 (docs/mcu.md section 11, re-log 64)

MusicLibrary _AOU243378_7_1 (0x3008530c, called by MLSSqliteVFSOpen): returns '<db>.cbk' for a library file iTunes signs (Locations.itdb) when the process may write the library (itdbprepserver, the iPod app), and the VFS then checks the file against that signed checksum file. ios3ds builds the library itself (scripts/music.py) and cannot sign it: return nil (mov r0,#0; bx lr), so every library file opens as a plain sqlite file (docs/audio.md section 10, re-log 77)

_plist_merge: like plist_set, but nested dictionaries are merged key by key instead of replaced
_encode_aac: encode-aac=false (plist_merge): the iPod2,1's only AAC encoder is ACAACEncoder_IOA2, the S5L8720 audio hardware's, which ios3ds does not have. With encode-aac Voice Memos asks Celestial for 'aac ', gets an iLBC 8 kHz .mov instead and its .mov -> .m4a pass-through remake fails with -50 (playback 'loading' forever); without it Voice Memos records Apple Lossless ('alac', software ACAppleLosslessEncoder), which .m4a holds (docs/audio.md section 9, re-log 77)
